summary: Postinstall beacon to webhook.site collector (dependency-confusion canary)
details: On `npm install`, package.json's postinstall hook runs `node probe.cjs`, which performs an unconditional HTTPS POST to a hardcoded webhook.site collector URL (https://webhook.site/a4bf0f9f-6d96-46e6-80ac-b76a5329f481) with the body `HELPER_AGENT_INSTALL_CANARY`. The request itself discloses to a third party that the package was installed on the host, along with the installer's source IP and TLS metadata. This is the standard shape of a dependency-confusion / internal-build-system probing canary: the package name is generic (`helper-agent`) and plausibly collides with a private/internal name, and the postinstall beacon lets the operator of the webhook.site endpoint discover which organizations resolve this public name instead of their internal one.
